description: This Java class `ExternalMessageFactory` serves as a factory for creating instances of `ExternalMessageBuilder`. It provides static methods to instantiate builders either from header maps or existing `ExternalMessage` objects, facilitating the construction of `ExternalMessage` instances.

classes.name: ExternalMessageFactory
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to create builders for ExternalMessage objects, preventing instantiation.

methods.name: newExternalMessageBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new ExternalMessageBuilder initialized with the given headers map.

methods.name: newExternalMessageBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new ExternalMessageBuilder based on the provided ExternalMessage object.
